name: Osybus Behemoth
resist: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

trait.name: Annihilating Aura
entries: Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution save or take 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Life Eater
entries: A creature dies if reduced to 0 hit points by the behemoth and can't be revived except by a {@spell wish} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Makes two Enervating Focus attacks, and uses Finger of Doom if available.

action.name: Enervating Focus
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 5d8 + 6}) necrotic damage. Target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Con save or its hit point max is reduced by damage taken.

action.name: Finger of Doom {@recharge 6}
entries: Points at a creature within 300 ft. {@dc 21} Wis save or take 39 ({@damage 6d12}) necrotic damage and become {@condition frightened} and {@condition paralyzed} until the end of the behemoth's next turn.
